noun_definition: web refers to the online platform accessed through a browser where users can log in and navigate to settings on the staging version of the Expensify application.
Settings refers to the configuration interface within the web application where users can adjust their preferences and account details.
Left refers to the side of the user interface where the settings are displayed in relation to the conversation that is opened on the right.
Conversation refers to the interaction or dialogue that is displayed on the right side of the settings interface in the web application.
Right refers to the side of the user interface where the status modal opens when navigating the settings in the web application.
